sections.label: 24-hour games centre licensing
sections.summary: Police consider location and law and order concerns for 24-hour amusement or computer games centre licences; one computer games centre holds such a licence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When assessing an application for a public entertainment licence to operate a 24-hour amusement or computer games centre, the Police will take into account the location of the centre and the likelihood of law and order concerns arising from the operation of the centre.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Currently, no amusement centre has been given a 24-hour licence under the public entertainment regulatory regime.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There are 27 computer games centres with public entertainment licences, but only one has been issued a 24-hour licence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This centre is not located in the heartlands and is not issued with a liquor licence for sale and consumption of liquor on its premises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Other than amusement and computer games centres licensed under the Public Entertainment regime which are open to members of the public, computer gaming societies which are registered with the Registry of Societies may also provide computer gaming services, but only to their members.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: None of them has been issued with liquor licences for sale and consumption of liquor on their premises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Although these computer gaming societies are not regulated under the public entertainment regime, the Police, nevertheless, do conduct enforcement checks on them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If they are found to be used for unlawful purposes, or their rules are shown to be inadequate for the proper management and control, the Registry of Societies will not hesitate to take action, including issuing warning letters and dissolving these societies.
